scope: Finite exploratory engineering gate, not population significance or adoption
required_for_either_candidate: nonzero actually changed independently observed geometry in both platforms
task IoU gain over source positive in both platforms under both summary weights
relevant center or size error reduction over source positive in both platforms under both summary weights
aggregate task gains exceed harms in both platforms
full direct feedback is better than its fixed half-shift control under both platform summary weights
additional_multiview_claim_requirement: positive task increment over single_instance_direct and unfiltered matched-gate aggregation; nonzero valid pointcorroboration, no wrongview acceptance shortcut
single_frame_branch_scope: If only the preregistered single-frame candidate passes, it may support an explicitly separate single-frame independent-mask TTA pilot, never a temporal contribution. Prefer multiview only if its full gate also passes; no per-platform best-arm mix.
conditional_TTA: Before any head updates root must lock actual new prediction input, fixed pre-update query readout, same-information direct pseudo output and exact frozen-feature kernel transfer controls. No teacher/EMA. Labels used to choose progression make this exploratory, not independent confirmation.
failure_action: Do not run regression updates on feedback lacking these prerequisites. Preserve positives/negatives/NA/zero and all inputs/failed input-stage estimator versions, no post-label threshold or coverage search.
registration_protocol: Input-only comparison of bounded classic SIFT-RGBD, ICP plus RGB validation, and one-depth PnP. Validation rules differ; counts are not a fair algorithm leaderboard. Final primary backend selected and locked before targetGT.
